title: Mutmaßlicher Drogenhändler mit scharfer Schusswaffe unterwegs – Haftbefehl erlassen

extraction.summaryEn: Police observed a suspected drug dealer selling narcotics at S-Bahn station Tempelhof, then arrested him at Hermannstraße station after a chase. He carried a firearm, ammunition, drugs and a knife, and an arrest warrant was issued.
